title: Why was my Diamond Elite application declined?
summary: This document explains why a Diamond Elite application may be declined: maintained balances below $250,000, account history not showing sustained balances at/above $250,000, or incomplete/current required information or documentation at review. It advises increasing and sustaining the balance to at least $250,000, completing documentation, and contacting the bank to request reconsideration after maintaining the threshold.
